title: Can LLMs Replace Human Evaluators? An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge in Software Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Reversing the order of two responses in pairwise comparison prompts to measure the agreement rate and evaluate model consistency when positions are swapped.

Qualitative analysis of LLM scoring behavior on code summarization tasks, observing the models' tendency to assign higher scores to overly detailed explanations despite task instructions requiring concise summaries.
